part.text:
Fixed. The issue was that child processes inherited the full OS environment: `Command::envs()` only *adds* variables, so a variable hidden with `hide-env` in nushell still leaked from the shell's own inherited environment to spawned children.

The fix (matching upstream nushell PR #12901) is in `spawn_simple_command` (crates/nu-command/src/system/run_external.rs:570): call `process.env_clear()` when constructing the child `Command`, so the child gets only the environment nushell explicitly passes (`process.envs(&self.env_vars)` in `create_process`, which already excludes hidden vars via `Stack::get_env_vars`).

- `nu-command` tests: 1480 passed; the 2 failures (`cd_permission_denied_folder`, `rm_prints_filenames_on_error`) are pre-existing on the baseline (confirmed via `git stash`)
